title: Crash in the wild in `RuntimeNodeSelect::_find_3d_items_at_rect`
body:
### Tested versions

This is another one of those crashes that we capture via telemetry in Xogot, and as usual, we do not have more information than this, but we are sharing because we suspect this is a root problem in Godot's editor and might be worth fixing for Godot users.

```
Crashed: Godot Main Thread [instance #2]
0  Xogot                          0x8eb7d68 World3D::get_scenario() const + 81 (world_3d.cpp:81)
1  Xogot                          0x8fa9868 RuntimeNodeSelect::_find_3d_items_at_rect(Rect2 const&, Vector<RuntimeNodeSelect::SelectResult>&) + 2737 (scene_debugger.cpp:2737)
2  Xogot                          0x8fa530c RuntimeNodeSelect::_physics_frame() + 1842 (scene_debugger.cpp:1842)
3  Xogot                          0xaa473ac Object::emit_signalp(StringName const&, Variant const**, int) + 1301 (object.cpp:1301)
4  Xogot                          0x6adb114 SceneTree::physics_process(double) + 640 (scene_tree.cpp:640)
5  Xogot                          0x1466a78 Main::iteration() + 4809 (main.cpp:4809)
6  Xogot                          0x15d3e8c MethodBindTR<bool>::ptrcall(Object*, void const**, void*) const + 58 (method_ptrcall.h:58)
7  Xogot                          0xa9c9d00 gdextension_object_method_bind_ptrcall(void const*, void*, void const* const*, void*) + 1435 (gdextension_interface.cpp:1435)
8  SwiftGodot                     0x324ed4 __swift_memcpy48_4 + 2315004
9  Xogot                          0x2bf404 closure #1 in GodotApp.iterate() + 914 (GodotAppView.swift:914)
10 Xogot                          0x283550 GodotInstance.scopedAttach<A>(callback:) + 432 (SwiftGodotKit.swift:432)
11 SwiftGodot                     0x3cf04 __swift_memcpy49_8 + 19532
12 Xogot                          0xa9ccd30 CallableCustomExtension::call(Variant const**, int, Variant&, Callable::CallError&) const + 172 (gdextension_interface.cpp:172)
13 Xogot                          0xaa0f2f4 std::__1::__function::__func<GodotInstance::execute(Callable, bool)::$_0, std::__1::allocator<GodotInstance::execute(Callable, bool)::$_0>, void ()>::operator()() + 887 (variant.h:887)
14 Xogot                          0xaa0ced4 TaskExecutor::invokeCallback(void*) + 395 (function.h:395)
15 Xogot                          0x2b4dc0 ThreadExecutor.execute(waitAfter:) + 185 (GodotAppView.swift:185)
16 Xogot                          0x2b5094 @objc ThreadExecutor.main() + 199 (GodotAppView.swift:199)
17 Foundation                     0x75804 __NSThread__start__ + 732
18 libsystem_pthread.dylib        0x3344 _pthread_start + 136
19 libsystem_pthread.dylib        0xab8 thread_start + 8
```

We are working on a fix that we will submit as a PR, but so far, it seems that this is a case of an object that is cached but can go away.   There is more than one place where this happens, so it is not clear what exactly triggered it, but a full fix probably needs to cover many different scenarios in that code.

### System information

iOS

### Issue description

Crash in the wild caught by telemetry

### Steps to reproduce

No steps are known,

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No project is known.
